project.name: TraceLab UX Research Repository
project.description: Personal-scale research repository with RAG search, Presidio-powered redaction, and mission protocol governance.

critical_facts: Sprint 01 delivers the ingestion and redaction foundation needed for later RAG features.
Presidio must be tuned using a synthetic corpus before any embeddings are generated.
Vector storage relies on Qdrant configured for on-disk segments with scalar quantization.
constraints: All document processing workflows must execute redaction prior to persistence or embedding.
Synthetic data only for evaluation until governance approves real corpus usage.
Local developer environment must function offline except for OpenAI API calls.
decisions_made: Adopt FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Alembic for core service bootstrapping.
Leverage Fake PII generation and presidio-research evaluator for regression testing.
achievements: Documented Sprint 01 missions with direct research cross-links.
Established automated sprint evaluation mission to support continuous planning.
Defined Sprint 01 telemetry plan and artifact naming for evaluator automation.

sprint_evaluation.run_protocol: Execute after each sprint demo; compare mission successCriteria against telemetry and append report reference here.

system_components.ingestion: Upload endpoints, format routing, redaction, chunking, and processing state tracking.
system_components.redaction: Presidio-based pipeline with custom recognizers and pseudonymization operators.
system_components.vector_store: Qdrant collection with on-disk storage, scalar quantization, and rescoring.
system_components.evaluation: Synthetic corpus generation + presidio-research metrics, sprint efficacy script.

planning.next_checkpoint: Complete B1.1 → B1.3 to unlock ingestion pipeline.
sprint_close_process: Run scripts/evaluate_sprint.py with --sprint <n> to generate report in cmos/reports/.
Update cmos/missions/backlog.yaml statuses and success metric outcomes.
Capture retrospective highlights in MASTER_CONTEXT.json under working_memory.domains.main.achievements.
